description: Figure 7 illustrates the performance of different query selection strategies, displaying MRR@10 and R@100 values. The x-axis is labeled “Variants” and consists of six categorical labels: “BM25”, “BM25 w/ expansion”, “CAPSTONE-DPR”, “CAPSTONE-DPR w/ max”, “CAPSTONE-DPR w/ median”, and “CoCondenser”. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and “R@100”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks every 10 units. There are two lines plotted on the graph. The first line is solid and blue, representing “MRR@10”, starting at approximately 36.68 at “BM25” and ending at approximately 98.61 at “CoCondenser”. The second line is dotted and orange, representing “R@100”, starting at approximately 97.02 at “BM25” and ending at approximately 98.60 at “CoCondenser”.
